message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
Solano's "Lisbon & Porto in Seven Days" (LP-0927) leaves Gatwick North on Saturday 27 September 2026 on SX 482 at 07:15 (check-in by 05:15) and returns from Porto on Friday 3 October on SX 489 at 18:40. Days 1–3 are in Lisbon: an orientation walk and included welcome dinner, Belém with Jerónimos Monastery, and a day in Sintra with Pena Palace and lunch. On Day 4 the group takes a reserved train to Porto. Day 5 includes a Ribeira walking tour, Livraria Lello and an afternoon port-cellar tour and tasting in Vila Nova de Gaia. Day 6 is the Douro Valley with a river cruise and quinta lunch; Day 7 is a free morning before the airport transfer at 15:00. The price is £1,395 per person sharing (single supplement £320), covering flights, transfers, six nights in 4-star hotels, stated meals and entries, and a tour manager. Each passenger can check in one bag of up to 32 kg, plus a 10 kg cabin bag. A £150 deposit is due at booking and the balance by 28 July. Cancel 30+ days before departure for a full refund; 29–15 days costs 50%, 14 days or fewer 100%. Passports must meet Schengen validity rules; expect up to three hours' walking a day on cobbles.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
SOLANO TRAVEL — "LISBON & PORTO IN SEVEN DAYS" (Small Group Tour, Departure Code LP-0927) Itinerary and Key Booking Conditions

Departure: Saturday 27 September 2026, flight SX 482 from London Gatwick (North Terminal) at 07:15, arriving Lisbon 09:55 local time. Please be at the check-in desk by 05:15. Return: Friday 3 October 2026, flight SX 489 from Porto at 18:40, arriving Gatwick 21:20.

Day 1 (Sat) — Lisbon. Transfer to Hotel Miradouro (4*). Afternoon orientation walk of the Baixa and Chiado with our tour manager. Welcome dinner included. Day 2 (Sun) — Lisbon. Guided tour of Belém, including entry to Jerónimos Monastery. Afternoon free. Breakfast included. Day 3 (Mon) — Sintra. Full-day excursion by coach to Sintra, with entry to Pena Palace. Breakfast and lunch included. Day 4 (Tue) — Lisbon to Porto. Morning Alfa Pendular train from Lisbon Santa Apolónia to Porto Campanhã (approx. 3 hours), reserved second-class seats. Check in to Hotel Ribeira Douro (4*). Breakfast included. Day 5 (Wed) — Porto. Guided walking tour of the Ribeira district and Livraria Lello (entry included). Optional port-cellar tour and tasting in Vila Nova de Gaia in the afternoon — this is not included in the tour price and costs €25 per person, payable locally in cash or by card. Breakfast included. Day 6 (Thu) — Douro Valley. Full-day excursion by coach with a river cruise from Pinhão and lunch at a quinta. Breakfast and lunch included. Day 7 (Fri) — Porto. Free morning. Transfer to Porto airport at 15:00 for flight home. Breakfast included.

Price. £1,395 per person sharing a twin or double room. Single room supplement £320. Price includes flights, 23 kg checked baggage per person, all transfers, six nights' accommodation, the meals stated above, entrance fees as stated, and the services of a tour manager throughout.

Baggage. Each passenger may check in one bag of up to 23 kg; bags of 23–32 kg are accepted at a fee of €60 per flight payable at the airport, and bags over 32 kg will not be accepted. One cabin bag up to 10 kg is included.

Deposit and payment. A deposit of £150 per person is required at the time of booking. The balance is due 60 days before departure (by 28 July 2026).

Cancellation by you. If you cancel 30 or more days before departure, we will refund all payments except the £150 deposit, which is non-refundable in all circumstances. If you cancel 29–15 days before departure, 50% of the total price is payable; 14 days or fewer, 100% is payable. We strongly recommend travel insurance.

Travel documents. British passport holders need a passport issued within the last 10 years on the date of entry and valid for at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area. From late 2026, travellers may also require ETIAS authorisation; we will advise.

Fitness. This tour involves walking on cobbled and steep streets for up to three hours a day.

Changes. We reserve the right to alter the order of excursions due to local conditions.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. My suitcase weighs 28 kg. Will I have to pay anything extra at the airport?
2. What time is the transfer to Porto airport on the last day?
3. We've paid in full and need to cancel 45 days before departure. How much will we get back?
4. Should I budget extra cash for the port-cellar tasting on Day 5?
response:
I checked the document itself rather than relying only on my earlier notes. **My notes were wrong on three points** (baggage allowance, cancellation refund, and the port tasting), so please use the answers below.

**1. Your 28 kg suitcase: yes, you'll pay extra.**
The price includes one checked bag of up to **23 kg**. Bags of 23–32 kg are accepted for **€60 per flight**, paid at the airport. You fly out and back, so that's likely **€120 in total**. My notes wrongly said 32 kg was included. If you can get the case under 23 kg, you pay nothing. Anything over 32 kg won't be accepted at all.

**2. Last-day transfer to Porto airport: 15:00** on Friday 3 October. Your flight (SX 489) leaves at 18:40.

**3. Cancelling 45 days before departure after paying in full:**
Cancelling 30 or more days out gets you a refund of everything **except the £150 deposit per person**, which is non-refundable in all circumstances. My notes wrongly said this was a full refund.
- Two people sharing: £2,790 paid − £300 deposits = **£2,490 back** (£1,245 each)
- Single room: £1,715 paid − £150 = **£1,565 back**

Travel insurance may cover the lost deposit, depending on why you're cancelling.

**4. Port-cellar tasting on Day 5: yes, budget for it.**
It's **optional and not included** in the tour price. It costs **€25 per person**, paid locally in cash or by card, so you don't strictly need cash. My notes wrongly listed it as included.

**One thing to check:** today is 13 November 2026, and this departure (LP-0927) ran from 27 September to 3 October 2026. If you're booked on a different departure, confirm with Solano that it has the same terms and dates, especially for the cancellation calculation.
